verdicts.rule_quote: To block a line, an obstruction must provide Total Cover.
verdicts.explanation: The scenario excludes the goblin behind Total Cover from the area, and it gives G1 (a creature) only Half Cover for G2. That matches clauses #3 and #4 and R-09, where creatures never give Total Cover. It doesn't cover #5 (unseen point), but that isn't what it's about.

verdicts.rule_quote: If all straight lines extending from the point of origin to a location in the area of effect are blocked, that location isn’t included in the area of effect.
verdicts.explanation: The test puts G3 behind Total Cover and asserts g3.hp == 10 with only 2 saves rolled. This checks that a location with Total Cover from the origin is excluded (#3/#4). It also checks that a creature in front gives only Half Cover (g2.hp == 10 - 6). It doesn't test the unseen-point placement in #5.

verdicts.evidence: if game.cover_between(caster if from_self else place[:2], t) == "total":
verdicts.rule_quote: If all straight lines extending from the point of origin to a location in the area of effect are blocked, that location isn’t included in the area of effect.
verdicts.explanation: The code excludes a target when it has Total Cover from the point of origin. That is reading A of both the 'location' and the 'per location' ambiguities (consistent with R-10), and it gives no special treatment to creatures. The code relies on that reading, so it's affected by the ambiguity. For an Emanation or from_self area it uses the caster's space as origin, which is the stage-A gap. The log tag has no clause number (`rule="GLOSS.area-of-effect"`).

summary: I checked 5 items against GLOSS.area-of-effect. The SPL-05 scenario and its test agree with clauses #3 and #4 (a target behind Total Cover is excluded, and a creature gives only Half Cover). The spells.py cover check at line 1136 follows reading A of the stage-A ambiguities. The two combat.py lines are about the Attack glossary entry and matched on page 177 only. None of the items covers clause #5 (an unseen point behind an obstruction).
